citation_occurrences.context_tex: Frozen original-split classifiers were evaluated without external tuning on UniProtKB/\allowbreak{}Swiss-Prot HUMSAVAR 2026\_03 \cite{UniProt2025}. Pathogenic/likely pathogenic and benign/likely benign records defined the two classes. After exact canonical-sequence mapping and reference-residue checks, original variants were excluded by the union of accession/node/gene-plus-substitution and dbSNP keys. The primary set excluded training/validation proteins and identical sequences (10,785 variants; 2,498 proteins); a nested stricter set additionally excluded original test proteins and identical sequences (6,934; 1,713). All remained frozen-graph nodes. BioGRID 5.0.262 physical-category edges \cite{Stark2006BioGRID}, excluding RNA-related methods and ambiguous mappings, yielded 931,458 undirected edges on the same 19,622 nodes. Nine additional matched fits covered BioGRID representation prediction and fusion in both splits. Protocols and complete metrics are in Supplementary Methods 5--6 and Tables 11--17.
